name: – Siegfried Mureşan – Motion for a resolution
title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 5/2024 of the European Union for the financial year 2024 - adjustment in payment appropriations, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text:
The European Parliament approves changes to the European Union's 2024 budget. The changes add about 2.95 billion euros in payments and 44.5 million euros in commitments. They also update the money coming in, including 2.82 billion euros in fines paid up to October 2024, such as a 2.4 billion euro competition fine on Google. New budget lines are created for the Ukraine Loan Cooperation Mechanism, which supports Ukraine through loans repaid from future revenue from frozen Russian state assets.

- Payments rise by 2.95 billion euros, mostly covered by fines and penalties.
- New budget lines fund support loans for Ukraine from frozen Russian asset revenue.
- Parliament approves the Council's position, so the budget change is adopted.
